chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) regarding Allah and regarding the Most Honorable Messenger.
ai.seo_question: What is the subject of Imam Ali's sermon in Nahj al-Balagha regarding the Prophet?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon in *Nahj al-Balagha* where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the theological foundation of the Prophetic mission, emphasizing the inseparable link between divine unity (*Tawhid*) and prophetic guidance. In Shia scholarship, this section is often cited to demonstrate the Imam’s role as the interpreter of the Quran, highlighting how the Prophet’s character serves as the living embodiment of Allah’s attributes. It underscores the concept of *Wilayah* as the practical manifestation of divine will in human history.
